user_input: What login methods does kayak.com support?
reference: Kayak supports email + password, Google OAuth 2.0, Facebook Login, Apple Sign-In (iOS app and Safari web only), and a magic link passwordless option currently in limited rollout on mobile.

user_input: What happens after 5 failed login attempts?
reference: 5 failed login attempts within a 10-minute window locks the account for 15 minutes and triggers an email alert to the account owner.

user_input: How long does a login session last if I don't check 'Remember me'?
reference: Without 'Remember me', the session expires after 24 hours of inactivity.

user_input: How long is a password reset link valid, and can it be reused?
reference: The password reset link is valid for 30 minutes and can only be used once (single-use).

user_input: What rate limiting is applied to the login endpoint?
reference: The /auth/login endpoint enforces a limit of 20 requests per minute per IP address; requests beyond that threshold receive HTTP 429 and trigger an hCaptcha challenge.

user_input: What token format and expiry does Kayak use after a successful login?
reference: Kayak issues a short-lived JWT access token with a 15-minute expiry, plus a refresh token stored as an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie.

user_input: What happens to other sessions when a user resets their password?
reference: All active sessions for the account are automatically logged out when a password reset occurs, requiring re-login on every device.

user_input: How does Kayak prevent revealing whether an email address is registered?
reference: Kayak uses generic error messaging for failed logins and the same generic confirmation message on password reset requests, so the system never reveals whether a given email exists in it.

user_input: What is the minimum password requirement for a Kayak account?
reference: Passwords must be at least 10 characters long, include at least one number and one symbol, and are checked against the Have I Been Pwned breach corpus at signup and password reset.

user_input: Can a user log in to Kayak using cryptocurrency wallet authentication?
reference: Kayak does not support cryptocurrency wallet authentication; this is not one of the supported login methods.
